name: Eye Tag
summary: Eye Tag is an indie multiplayer VR social game (and Gorilla Tag fan game) where players take on the unique avatar form of an eyeball rather than a gorilla or primate.  Using the same style of hands-only, physics-driven momentum locomotion popularized by Gorilla Tag, players run, jump, and traverse the map using arm and hand movements—all while playing tag and hanging out in lobbies with friends.
